:::{#exm-best-predictor-argmin}
#### The minimizer in the best-predictor exercise

In @exr-best-predictor, the [conditional expectation function](#def-cond-expectation-function) $\bestpredfnf{\Predvar}$ has [risk](#def-risk) $1$.
The constant [prediction function](#def-prediction-function) $\predfn_1$, with $\predfn_1\paren{\Predvar} = 3$, has risk $5$ and $\predfn_2\paren{\Predvar} = 4\Predvar$ has risk $2$, both larger than $1$.
So $\bestpredfn$ is the [minimizer](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/algebra-basics.html#def-global-minimizer) among the three.

:::
